title: minitrace v0.3.0 judge-session extensions
description: Constraints specific to judge-session traces. A judge-session represents a panel judgment over one or more other traces. Per spec §13, a conformant trace validates against the base schema plus this type-specific schema; validating does not by itself make a trace conformant, since the schemas check a subset of the text.

lineage.description: judge-session traces MUST carry at least one lineage edge identifying the trace(s) being judged.
